task: #17 judge calibration - human (author) blind fidelity labels vs Llama 3.1 8B judge
sample: 40 rows stratified from the 783-triplet natural audit: 20 judge-SUPPORTED, 10 ENTITY_ERROR, 5 UNSUPPORTED, all 5 RELATION_ERROR flags

sheets.labels: phase34_judge_calibration_blind_v2.csv (with source passages; v1 lacked passages and was relabeled)

judge_flag_precision.entity_error: 0/10 (95% upper bound ~0.26 by rule of three)
judge_flag_precision.relation_error: 1/5 (census - all 5 RELATION flags in the audit were checked; exactly 1 is a real error, and it is actually QUALIFIER_LOSS)

judge_supported_check: 0/20 judge-SUPPORTED rows contained a human-identified error (upper 95% ~0.14; recall not tightly bounded)

corrected_natural_error_rate.point_estimate: ~0.9% (7.4/783), wide CI; order of magnitude below the naive rate

fever_gap_artifact: 6/6 FEVER flags in the sample were false alarms. The three world-false FEVER claims (Aarhus south of London, 198 musicians, CONCACAF South America) were faithfully extracted but flagged - the judge leaked world knowledge into a fidelity task, exactly what its system prompt forbade. The FEVER 40.4% vs HotpotQA 10.1% 'context richness' finding is therefore largely a judge artifact, not an extraction property.
qualifier_loss: Judge found 0 QL in 783; human found 1 QL in 40 (judge had miscategorized it as RELATION_ERROR) - judge QL-insensitivity confirmed.
convergent_finding: Judge flag precision 10% here ~= ValidationAgent quarantine precision 8-10% in the mitigated runs, measured independently. The full-Trio net harm has a mechanism: a low-precision judge of this model grade mostly flags good nodes.
limitations: Single human rater (thesis author), post-hoc but blind to key; stratified sample so overall agreement is not a population estimate; optional second rater (Claude Haiku) parked.
